title: I Blew Out the Candles Before Making a Wish

title_lang.en: I Blew Out the Candles Before Making a Wish

synopsis: Young JoJo suddenly comes into a stack of casino chips worth a million and decides to pay off her runaway father’s debt, asking the down-on-his-luck debt collector Hua to gamble on her behalf. In Macau’s chaotic casinos, they form an unlikely alliance, navigating wins, losses, and life’s challenges together. When the final bet arrives, fate cruelly tests them, stripping them of everything, yet revealing the true gift life has been offering.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
從天而降的百萬籌碼，讓小女孩JOJO動了幫走佬父親還債的念頭，為了將「天主的禮物」化成現金，JOJO央求來家裡收數的志華替她進賭場代賭。一事無成的志華目標只有追回已經變心的妻子，他以為保住層樓才有機會追回她，但奈何他連這個月供樓錢都沒有。

 

急需金錢的兩人一拍即合，通過賭桌上翻轉的牌面，贏錢的喜悅逐漸拉近兩人距離。可久賭必輸，JOJO和志華決定利用僅存的籌碼放手一博，豈料事情並非那麼單純，命運的玩笑讓兩人失去所有，也在那一刻，JOJO和志華才真正收到上天給予的禮物。

cast: Kai Ko, MUI Cheng, Elaine Jin, Stanley Yau, Tou Chung Hua
